headline: Frontline Clashes Escalate Across Weathered Expanse and Northern Sectors
war_summary: Combat across the contested northern and central belts has concentrated into a violent flurry of base exchanges over the past three hours, led by renewed upheavals in Weathered Expanse, Mooring County, and Linn of Mercy. In Weathered Expanse, seven base transitions erupted within the last two hours around Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch alongside seventeen hundred casualties, leaving six positions under Warden control, one Colonial, and two in no-man's-land. Mooring County sustained its grinding collision with five further base shifts and over thirty-six hundred combined dead in two hours, even as Colonials retained a second foothold against ten Warden forts. Linn of Mercy registered four rapid base exchanges at Outwich Ranch and Rotdust with accelerating casualties on both sides, while Callum's Cape added two transitions amid thirty-four hundred fresh losses. To the south, an offshore clash in Lykos Isle saw Wardens wrest The Squall from Colonial grasp. In contrast, the previous base turnover in Stonecradle and Marban Hollow has stalled over the last two hours, though sharp attrition in Marban Hollow accelerated markedly.
